title: Any logged-in user can read another user's transfer
summary: Any logged-in user can read another user's transfer
expected: 404 for a user who neither sent nor received the transfer (REQ-VIS, INV-2)
actual: 200 with amount, memo and wallet ids of the other users' transfer
reproduction_steps: Register users A, B and C
A deposits and transfers to C
B requests GET /transfers/{id} of A's transfer

hypotheses.statement: Logic in get_transfer does not enforce the stated rule
